tools.description: Search a health-probed directory of live x402 pay-per-call HTTP endpoints on Base, Solana and other networks (x402_index_stats gives the current count). Returns id, resource URL, method, network, USD price, description, 30-day call/payer counts and our own uptime/probe data. Data is re-crawled a few times a day, not real-time. Quietforge operates this directory and also operates some listed endpoints (source=quietforge) under the same per-host cap as every operator; ordering is by 30-day usage, then liveness, then freshness, never by operator.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the resource URL, description and service name.
q.title: Q

network.description: CAIP-2 network id to filter on, e.g. eip155:8453 (Base mainnet); omit for all networks.
network.title: Network

alive.description: true = answered its paid route on our last probe; false = did not; omit for both.
alive.title: Alive

max_price_usd.description: Only endpoints priced at or below this USD amount per call.
max_price_usd.title: Max Price Usd

source.description: Listing source: cdp (Coinbase CDP bazaar), payai (PayAI discovery) or quietforge (our own endpoints).
source.title: Source

limit.description: Page size, 1-100; out-of-range values are clamped.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging; negative is treated as 0.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: x402_search
tools.title: Search the x402 endpoint directory

tools.description: One endpoint from the x402 service index by id (from x402_search), with its last 20 health probes (status code, latency, alive) and uptime across them.

id.description: Service id exactly as returned by x402_search.
id.title: Id

tools.name: x402_service
tools.title: Get one x402 endpoint with probe history

tools.description: Summary of the x402 service index: totals, how many endpoints answered on the last probe, counts per network and per source, and when the crawl ran.
tools.name: x402_index_stats
tools.title: x402 directory size and breakdown

tools.description: Market-level demand signal for the x402 ecosystem, verified against on-chain USDC settlement on Base rather than self-reported call counts: how many seller addresses were paid in the last 24h, total USD settled, and the distribution of sellers by payment count. Free and aggregate-only; the per-seller breakdown (distinct payers per address; payer counts include sampler/grader wallets that pay many sellers once, so read them as an upper bound on customers) is the paid GET /v1/x402/demand route. Refuses to answer rather than serve a stale snapshot.
tools.name: x402_demand
tools.title: x402 market demand, on-chain, last 24h

tools.description: Make ONE live unpaid request to a public http(s) URL and report whether it is an x402 endpoint: status code, latency, alive flag, whether a PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge came back and the parsed USD price. GET only, except that a URL already in the index is probed with its listed method. Public hosts only (redirects re-checked), delisted hosts never contacted, results cached 60 s, 3 probes per host per 5 min and 30 per minute overall.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to probe, max 2048 chars; public hosts only.
url.title: Url

method.description: HTTP method. GET unless the URL is already in the index with a different listed method (then that method is allowed).
method.title: Method

tools.name: x402_probe
tools.title: Probe one URL for an x402 payment challenge

tools.description: Generate ONE sudoku puzzle with a unique solution, 180-degree symmetry, graded by the solving techniques it needs (easy | medium | hard | expert). Returns 81-char puzzle and solution strings (row by row, 0 = empty), given count and technique list. Deterministic when a seed is supplied. 20 per minute shared by all clients.

level.description: Difficulty by solving technique: easy, medium, hard or expert.
level.title: Level

seed.description: Integer 1-2147483647 for a reproducible puzzle; omit for a random one.
seed.title: Seed

tools.name: sudoku_puzzle
tools.title: Generate one solver-verified sudoku

tools.description: List Quietforge's paid x402 routes (document conversion, PDF text extraction, URL/HTML → PNG/JPEG/PDF rendering, sudoku books, manuscript typesetting, x402 index JSON API) with USD prices, the pay-to address and network, and how an x402 client pays. Free, read-only.
tools.name: quietforge_pricing
tools.title: Quietforge paid x402 routes and prices
